sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:66

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:66:1
items.html: The counterpart of the upper AVI are ZA and Rachel, who are equal in their stature, and the counterpart of YESHSUT are Jacob and Rachel the small, from the Chazeh of ZA and below: This has already been explained in the adjacent item: the seven lower ones and Rachel, who are equal in their stature, took the VAK of MA and the VAK of BON; and Jacob and Rachel the small took the Malchut of MA and the Malchut of BON. See there.
